cli.index.headless_login:
No graphical session is available and VOKO is not signed in. Run these commands in an interactive terminal:
  voko login
  voko manage_agent_registration --interactive
Then restart with voko start --no-open.
Alternatively, use SSH forwarding: ssh -L {port}:127.0.0.1:{port} user@server
